title: oenanthe silaifolia subsp. montana
intro: Oenanthe silaifolia subsp. montana, commonly known as Mountain Water Fern, is a type of plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is native to mountainous regions and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects. Additionally, Mountain Water Fern has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, making it a valuable resource in herbal medicine.
